units.source_text: （五）关于此书之注释本，在日本甚多，主要者可举六种：

en.t: (5) As for annotated editions of this book, there are very many in Japan; six of the principal ones may be named:

units.source_text: 藤原定家《源氏物语注释》、四辻善成《河海抄》、一条兼良《花鸟余情》、

en.t: Fujiwara no Teika's Commentary on The Tale of Genji, Yotsutsuji Yoshinari's Kakaisho, Ichijo Kaneyoshi's Kacho Yosei,

units.source_text: 三条西公条《细流抄》、中院通胜《岷江入楚》、北村季吟《湖月抄》。

en.t: Sanjonishi Kin'eda's Sairyusho, Nakanoin Michikatsu's Mingoe nissho, and Kitamura Kigin's Kogetsusho.

units.source_text: 现代日语译本亦甚多，主要者为谷崎润一郎译本、与谢野晶子译本、佐成谦太郎对译本。

en.t: There are also very many modern Japanese translations; the principal ones are the translations by Tanizaki Jun'ichiro and Yosano Akiko, and the parallel translation by Sanari Kentaro.

units.source_text: 今此中文译本乃参考各家译注而成。

en.t: The present Chinese translation was made with reference to the translations and annotations of various scholars.

units.source_text: 原本文字古雅简朴，有似我国《论语》《檀弓》，

en.t: The language of the original is archaic, elegant, and plain, somewhat like our Analects and Tangong,

units.source_text: 因此不宜全用现代白话文翻译。

en.t: and therefore it would not be appropriate to translate it entirely in modern vernacular prose.

units.source_text: 今试用此种笔调译出，恨未能表达原文之风格也。

en.t: I have now tried to translate it in this kind of style, though I regret that I have not been able to convey the character of the original.
